statements.text: In a dry run, an op for ADD-03:6.1 replacing ADD-02:T1-1-rev with ADD-03:T1-1 failed check C22 ('the provision cites no clause, table, form or section that exists in the pack'). ADD-03:6.1 belongs to another batch.

evidence.words: (1)  The technical score threshold in Volume I Clause 11.3 is unchanged at seventy (70) marks.
A Proposal whose technical score is less than seventy per cent (70%) of the total marks available in Table 1-1 shall not proceed to commercial evaluation.

statements.text: The threshold before ADD-03 is stated in marks: ADD-02 note (1) to Table 1-1 (revised) reads 'unchanged at seventy (70) marks'. ADD-03 Clause 6.2 restates it as 70% of the total marks available in Table 1-1.

Rows A to F of ADD-03 Table 1-1 are the content of the replacement table issued under ADD-03:6.1. They carry no amending words of their own and reproduce the ADD-02 rows unchanged, so each one changes nothing by itself. The replacement is the op that answers ADD-03:6.1.

Rows G and Total add new evaluation content: a new criterion worth 20 marks, and the total rises from 100 to 120. That content takes effect only through the replacement under ADD-03:6.1. Its op is in another batch and failed C22 in the dry run, so this batch cannot establish how these rows are carried. A person must decide, together with the 6.1 item and with 6.2/S6 for the threshold.
